title: Galley Fire Extinguisher
contents: property | Base Item | Commercial Fire Extinguisher
property | Price New | 40 credits | Bulk | L
text | A dented foam extinguisher recovered from its twisted galley bracket.
text | Spray foam in a 15-foot cone. Automatically extinguish nonmagical fires; attempt to counteract magical fire effects at 2nd rank with a +7 counteract modifier.
text | Each use expends 1 chem. Uses a chem tank of commercial grade or lower.
boxes | 2 | 1.5 | Mark one box per use.

property | Price New | 20 credits | Bulk | L

text | Provides the toolkit required for Computers checks to Hack. The commercial model grants no item bonus.
text | Access a computer without its normal user interface through physical contact or through an infosphere or similar linked network.

title: Hypopen (Commercial)
contents: property | Price New | 40 credits | Bulk | L
text | An intact nanite injector recovered from behind a damaged medical cabinet.
text | Remove the fatigued condition, or decrease the value of clumsy or sickened by 1.
text | Inject yourself or a creature within reach that is willing or unable to prevent the injection.
boxes | 1 | 1.5 | Mark when used; single dose.

title: Chief's Maintenance Chip
contents: property | Base Item | Data Chip (Player Core 239, 241)
property | Blank Chip Price | 2 credits | Bulk | negligible

text | Emergency system diagrams, connector specifications, and the cockpit separation checklist.
text | Chief's annotated ship photographs: model names, replacement parts circled, and short notes about repairs.
text | These files concern the pictured ships and their equipment. They grant no automatic skill bonus.

title: Crew Infinity Deck
contents: property | Base Item | Infinity Deck (Player Core 240-241)
property | Price New | 2 credits | Bulk | negligible
text | A worn deck of playing cards recovered from a zipped jacket pocket. A handwritten score sheet is folded into the case.
text | An infinity deck can be used to play numerous card games. It grants no listed mechanical bonus.

title: Recovered Air Regulator
contents: property | Suggested Bulk | L | Price | Negotiated
text | An intact pressure regulator removed from behind a hab service panel. The inlet and outlet fittings and stamped part number remain legible.
text | A replacement component for compatible air-handling machinery. It needs installation in a functioning system.
text | Does not generate oxygen, refill suits by itself, or grant a skill bonus.
text | A technician can inspect its condition and fittings to determine whether it suits their equipment.
